critical.issue: aiCharacterIds / aiCharacterId are NOT validated against the roster. Posting aiCharacterIds:['does_not_exist_xyz'] returns 200 and creates an ACTIVE session whose AI seat can never act (ai_service.get_character returns None -> run_ai_turns/preview_run_ai_turns silently `return`). Reproduced: after the human acts, phase stays 'answering' with submitted={'preview_p1':True,'nope_xyz':False} forever — the session is permanently stuck (a preview has no abandon path at all). Validate the id exists AND is enabled, return 400/404, and log a warning when get_character() returns None instead of returning silently.

minor.issue: Every failure mode (missing character, decide_action -> None, GameError) exits the loop quietly, so a stuck AI turn is indistinguishable from 'waiting for human'. Only the GameError branch logs. Add a logger.warning for the character-missing / action-None cases and surface a 'aiError' flag on the public doc.

No cost guard: each AI-opponent preview round fires 1 LLM completion per AI move (a full 8-round trivia preview = 8+ completions) billed to EMERGENT_LLM_KEY, with no rate limit on the preview endpoints (unlike /api/ai/chat). Any admin can loop this.

issues: Filtering/pagination is fully client-side over all 70 characters fetched at once — fine at 70, but there is no server-side paging/limit for when the roster grows.
No 'clear all filters' affordance; the user must reset country and language selects individually (minor).

action_items: Validate aiCharacterIds/aiCharacterId against the enabled roster in games_service.create_session() and preview_start(); reject with 400/404 instead of creating an unplayable session.
Log (and ideally expose) AI-turn failures in run_ai_turns/preview_run_ai_turns rather than returning silently.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_play.decide_action can return {'type':'answer','value':None} when both tmpl['options'] and prompt options are empty; apply_action would then raise and the AI turn is dropped silently — guard for empty option sets.

run_ai_turns re-reads the authoritative private doc on every one of MAX_AI_STEPS iterations and applies each AI move in its own transaction; for multi-AI sessions this is N+1 Firestore round trips per human action. Acceptable now (2-player), but cap/batch before group play with >1 AI.
Preview sandbox AI drives are unbounded LLM spend from an admin-only endpoint with no rate limit — add the same limiter used on /api/ai/chat.

rca_of_the_issue: server.play_create/games_preview_start pass the caller-supplied aiCharacterIds straight into games_service.create_session/_new_auth without any existence check. The engine happily seats the unknown id as a player (it appears in auth['ai'] and in submitted/scores), but ai_service.get_character(target) returns None inside run_ai_turns/preview_run_ai_turns, which then `return`s without logging. Result: the AI seat has available_actions but no actor, so the round never reaches both-submitted and the session/preview is stuck in 'answering' indefinitely.
